title: Vault and Safe Storage Credit Conditions, Larkspur Valuables Floater
content:
## Larkspur Valuables Floater conditions: vault and safe storage credits

**Grant of the credits.** A vault credit is granted only for jewelry and watches kept in a bank safe-deposit box, and a safe credit only where the residence has a central-station alarm and a home safe; the floater records one of vault, safe or none as its storage credit, and never both credits.

**Tiers without a credit.** On a tier whose vault credit percentage or safe credit percentage is 0, the matching credit is never recorded.

**Vault-rated item out of the vault at the time of loss.** A vault-rated item that is out of the vault when lost is paid only when the named insured told the carrier of its removal before the loss, in which case the premium for the days out of the vault is charged at the full class rate; otherwise the loss is paid at the tier's vault credit percentage less than the amount otherwise payable.

**Safe credit.** A safe credit carries no such condition.

## Branch table for a lost vault-rated item

| Where the item was when lost | Named insured told the carrier of its removal before the loss | Payment | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| In the vault | not relevant | amount otherwise payable | unchanged |
| Out of the vault | yes | amount otherwise payable | the days out of the vault charged at the full class rate |
| Out of the vault | no | amount otherwise payable, less the tier's vault credit percentage of it | unchanged |

## Points of judgement

- Which credit applies is read from the floater's record: vault, safe or none. There is never a floater recording both.
- On the Valuables Floater Classic both percentages are 0, so neither credit is recorded; on the Valuables Floater Select the vault percentage is 0, so a vault credit is never recorded there.
- A floater recording the safe credit has no condition of this kind on a loss; the out-of-vault condition belongs to the vault credit alone.

## Hypothetical case

A hypothetical Valuables Floater Preferred recording a vault credit (40 percent). A bracelet is lost while out of the vault, and the amount otherwise payable is 8000 USD. The named insured had not told Larkspur it had been taken out: the loss is paid at 40 percent less, 8000 USD less 3200 USD, which is 4800 USD. Had the named insured told Larkspur before the loss, 8000 USD would be paid and the premium for the days out of the vault charged at the full jewelry rate.
